verdict.rationale: ROS 2's own GitHub page says its ecosystem spans 'drivers to state-of-the-art algorithms'. Community users confirm a large body of existing ROS nodes and drivers, shared message packages, and batteries-included SLAM and motion planning that can be reused. However, the pack never documents a package registry or the mechanism for pulling packages; it only shows that the ecosystem exists. missing for 10: documentation of a package index or registry and how to discover and install packages, a dependency-resolution or install workflow for third-party driver packages, concrete examples of hardware driver packages being pulled in for bring-up.

support.subject: As a developer, I can pull reusable packages or modules from a registry or ecosystem for common hardware and behaviors

citations.quote: so many existing ROS nodes and drivers
shared message packages (e.g. vision_msgs) let libraries like object recognition and planning interoperate without glue code
batteries-included platform with SLAM and simple motion planning
